title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 115 ]

blocks.text: The most satisfying and expressive drawing is done with the active engagement of the entire body. Your hand is connected to your whole arm, the arm to the torso, supported by your feet on the floor. To awaken the active engagement of your whole body in drawing, try the following: Begin by drawing small circles in space with each of your fingers. Then move your hands in circles around the wrist. Next, make bigger circles with your forearms. And finally, make giant swinging arm circles. Now you see how your entire body can be used in the activity of drawing.

readingSentences.english: The most satisfying and expressive drawing is done with the active engagement of the entire body.
readingSentences.korean: 가장 만족스럽고 표현력이 풍부한 그림은 온몸을 적극적으로 쓰면서 그려진다.

readingSentences.english: Your hand is connected to your whole arm, the arm to the torso, supported by your feet on the floor.
readingSentences.korean: 손은 팔 전체와, 팔은 몸통과 이어져 있고, 몸통은 바닥을 디딘 발이 받쳐 준다.

readingSentences.english: To awaken the active engagement of your whole body in drawing, try the following: Begin by drawing small circles in space with each of your fingers.
readingSentences.korean: 그림을 그릴 때 온몸을 적극적으로 쓰는 감각을 깨우려면 다음과 같이 해 보라. 먼저 손가락 하나하나로 허공에 작은 원을 그린다.

readingSentences.english: Then move your hands in circles around the wrist.
readingSentences.korean: 그다음 손목을 중심으로 손을 원을 그리며 돌린다.

readingSentences.english: Next, make bigger circles with your forearms.
readingSentences.korean: 이어서 팔뚝으로 더 큰 원을 그린다.

readingSentences.english: And finally, make giant swinging arm circles.
readingSentences.korean: 마지막으로 팔을 크게 휘둘러 커다란 원을 그린다.

readingSentences.english: Now you see how your entire body can be used in the activity of drawing.
readingSentences.korean: 이제 그림 그리기에 온몸이 어떻게 쓰일 수 있는지 알게 되었을 것이다.
